description: check_oid_consistency (line 314) returns Error::SignatureInvalid when the outer signatureAlgorithm differs from the inner TBSCertificate.signature. SignatureInvalid semantically means the cryptographic signature bytes are wrong. An OID mismatch is a structural/encoding violation (RFC 5280 section 4.1.1.2 requirement), not a signature failure. This conflation makes it harder for callers to distinguish 'cert is malformed' from 'cert is tampered'. A distinct Error::MalformedCertificate or Error::AlgorithmMismatch variant should be used, or at minimum the existing error should be renamed/documented to cover this case.
title: check_oid_consistency returns SignatureInvalid for OID mismatch — wrong error type
